title: CucumberMod-Crops+
description: Adds cucumbers to Minecraft! Grow fresh crops, find salt on beaches, and enjoy new foods like pickled cucumbers and sandwiches. Fully supports 7 languages!
body:
# 🥒 Cucumber | Fresh Crops & Deli Foods

**Cucumber** is a modular expansion for the **Crops+** ecosystem. It adds a complete cucumber farming and culinary experience to Minecraft without any of the "bloat" found in traditional large food mods. 

Designed with a **"Zero-Waste" philosophy**, this mod ensures that if you only want cucumbers, you only get cucumbers—keeping your inventory clean and your game fast.

---

### ✨ Features / 特徴

*   🌿 **Farm Fresh:** Grow cucumbers from seeds with high-quality textures.
*   🥪 **New Foods:** Craft the refreshing **Cucumber Sandwich** and the tangy **Pickled Cucumber**.
*   🧂 **Salt Integration:** Works seamlessly with the **Crops+** shared salt system.
*   🌍 **Global:** Fully translated into **7 major languages**.

---

### 🚜 How to Start / 始め方

1.  **Find Seeds:** Break tall grass or ferns to discover **Cucumber Seeds**.
2.  **Gather Salt:** Dig up sand on **beaches** to find Salt (from Crops+).
3.  **Cultivate:** Plant seeds on farmland and watch them grow.
4.  **Craft:** Combine cucumbers with bread or salt to create new meals!

---

### 🧩 The Crops+ Advantage
This mod is built on the **Crops+ Framework**. It shares resources like Salt with other mods in the series (e.g., Tomato). **No duplicate items, perfect compatibility.**

---

### 📦 Requirements / 必須環境
*   📦 **[Crops+](https://modrinth.com/mod/crops-plus)** (Core Library)
*   ⚙️ **Fabric API**

---

### 🌐 Supported Languages
English / 日本語 / 简体中文 / Русский / Español / Português / Deutsch

---

### 🛠️ Technical Info
*   **Platform:** Fabric
*   **Version:** 1.20.1 (Newer versions coming soon!)
